missingOwnerInputs.required: Owner-designated immutable approval store or signature verifier, canonical approval ID/hash, revocation reader and operator-stop channel; authentication/secret setup handled separately
missingOwnerInputs.why: A self-asserted approved boolean must never create prospective authority. Choosing the trust anchor is an owner decision.

missingOwnerInputs.required: Exact admissible source manifest/bytes, provenance/rights/completeness field mappings, original receipt clocks and finite approved capture IDs
missingOwnerInputs.why: Fixture or reconstruction data must not be relabeled as genuine contemporaneous evidence.

missingOwnerInputs.required: Authoritative execution/commit clock contract, durable atomic attempt/read/write/byte counters and approved ceilings, exact population/window and queue partitions

proposedRuntimeSequence: Read and verify the immutable approval plus current revocation/stop state through the designated trusted reader; bind exact candidate/dependency/source/opportunity hashes and actual target/service identity.

Atomically reserve a single attempt against durable total/day/issuance/batch/resource counters; zero new provider calls. Reject wrong population, expiry, missing inputs or any exceeded cap without opening broader scope.
Capture the due opportunity independently of successful prediction. Use existing source, episode, lock, claim, feature and fitted-availability validation without relaxing cutoff fences.
Generate and persist pinned private unqualified outputs. Recheck stop/authority/clock/lock and current claim before atomic publication; obtain committed readback proof from the same authorized store.
A post-lock readback remains retained evidence but cannot be labeled eligible. Retry only within existing issuance/attempt bounds; append actual misses/failures, never backfill a live vintage.

Record actual operation/resource counters, approval/capture references and immutable artifact/readback hashes. Stop new admission at any cap, while preserving permanent history and separately authorized settlement/recovery procedures.
requiredLocalAcceptanceCases: Missing/untrusted/self-supplied, expired, future-window, revoked or wrong-environment approval produces no prospective publication.
Wrong code/model/protocol/source/game/player/profile hash or capture-class mismatch refuses issuance and preserves opportunity/missingness evidence.
Repeated invocation/concurrent claim cannot reset durable attempt/storage/request caps; cancellation and stale claim CAS never publish or manufacture a gap.
Clock rollback, start correction, play-begun fence or readback after lock cannot create eligible pregame evidence.
Draft recovery matches exact original authority and receipt; wrong-scope existing draft cannot be adopted.
Unqualified private shadow works without public qualification; public API/page and RSO remain disabled.
Process interruption/recovery, artifact loss/restore and official outcome correction retain the same immutable lineage and requested denominators.

publicReleaseSmokeProposal.artifactVerification: Use an already-retained approved archive/reproduction receipt and hashes; do not invent a public artifact-download route. If direct hosted archive verification is necessary, register its operation/resource budget and authorization separately before execution.
beforeAnyRequest: Require independent qualified scope and exact target/candidate approval; the current candidate has enabled:false, repository:null and page notFound:true.
Review future serving repository construction and routes for read-only bounded behavior; current route names alone do not authorize requests or prove future costs.
Inventory every linked Vercel project/root/trigger/ignored-build behavior and existing exact-SHA deployments. Do not assume root/web plus functions local links form the entire remote inventory.
Complete approved real IDs, expected immutable response references, at-most-five route budget, rollback target and named operator. No new builds, provider reads or schedules are implicit.
publicReleaseSmokeProposal.stop: Stop at the first unexpected identity, unsupported qualification exposure, non-read-only fanout, failed integrity check or resource bound. Otherwise stop once conclusive within five requests. Do not retry or expand to a browser crawl.
publicReleaseSmokeProposal.rollbackProposal: Named release owner separately approves the exact reversible disable action or prior successful deployment before release. Disable only v2 serving; preserve v1/RSO, existing essential schedules, immutable records and artifacts. Rollback request/build cost needs its own stated allowance; do not assume it fits the five-read budget.
